subject: general
question: Which architectural style characterises the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT) building in Mumbai, India, completed in 1887?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Victorian Gothic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT)**, formerly known as Victoria Terminus, is an iconic railway station in **Mumbai, India**.
 
• It was completed in the year **1887** to commemorate the Golden Jubilee of Queen Victoria's reign.
 
• The architectural style of the building is a blend of **Victorian Gothic Revival** and traditional **Indian architectural elements**.
 
• Key features of the Victorian Gothic style include the use of **pointed arches, turrets, spires, stained glass windows, and intricate carvings**.
 
• The design of CSMT was conceptualized by **Frederick William Stevens**, a British architect.
 
• The building has been recognized as a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** due to its exceptional architectural design and historical significance.
 
• It is one of the finest examples of **British colonial architecture** in India and represents the fusion of **Western and Indian design elements**.
 
• The terminus serves as a major hub for both suburban and long-distance trains, making it a critical part of Mumbai’s **transportation infrastructure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mughal Architecture**__

 __
 
• This style is characterized by **domes, minarets, intricate carvings, and large gardens**. It was prominent during the reign of the **Mughal emperors** in India.
 
• Famous examples include the **Taj Mahal**, **Red Fort**, and **Humayun’s Tomb**.
 
 
 
• **Indo-Saracenic Architecture**__
 __
 
• This style emerged during the **British colonial period** and combines **Indian, Islamic, and European architectural elements**.
 
• Examples include the **Gateway of India** in Mumbai and the **Madras High Court**.
 
 
 
• **Rajput Architecture**__
 
 
• Characterized by **opulent palaces, intricate carvings, domes, and jharokhas**, Rajput architecture is indigenous to the **Rajasthan region**.
 
• Famous examples include the **City Palace in Jaipur** and **Mehrangarh Fort**.
